'''March 2001 Indianapolis tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in In Your Face Comix, Indianapolis, Indiana on 17 March 2001. [[Rich Dailey]] won it. It is known from Eric Bailey's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1917">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-indianapolis-in-3-17-01d1917/ indianapolis-in-3-17-01], DeckTech (Eric "YOYOY" Bailey, 19 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-indianapolis-in-3-17-01d1917/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 17 March 2001
* '''Site:''' In Your Face Comix, Indianapolis, Indiana
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Rich Dailey]]
